2. Key Legal Terms in Legislation and Compliance
A. Essential Terms in Legal Statutes
A written law enacted by a legislative body
"The new statute increases penalties for tax fraud."
A formal law passed by a legislative body
"The Data Protection Act regulates the use of personal information."
A local law enacted by a municipal authority
"The city passed an ordinance banning smoking in public spaces."
A rule issued by a government agency to enforce a law
"Financial institutions must comply with banking regulations."
A proposed law before it becomes an act
"The environmental protection bill was debated in Congress."
level of legal authority (national, regional, or local law)
B. Key Compliance and Enforcement Terms
"Companies must ensure compliance with labor laws."
The act of ensuring compliance with a law
"The agency is responsible for the enforcement of environmental regulations."
"Failure to comply may result in financial sanctions."
The authority of a legal body to govern
"The court lacks jurisdiction over foreign entities."
The purpose behind enacting a law
"Courts interpret statutes based on legislative intent."

3. Challenges in Translating Legal Statutes and Regulations
Legal terms must reflect statutory meaning in the target jurisdiction
Some words do not have direct equivalents
Statutory language uses archaic and technical terminology
"The new statute mandates compliance with safety standards."
"Failure to adhere to this regulation shall result in penalties."
"The ordinance prohibits construction in protected areas."
Legal terms may have multiple meanings
Passive voice is common in statutes
Identify potential translation issues in this sentence:
"Any person who fails to comply with this provision shall be subject to enforcement actions as determined by the regulatory authority."
4. Reading Practice: Legal Texts in Context
Read the following legal excerpts aloud and analyze the terminology used.
Text 1: Excerpt from a National Statute
"The Data Protection Act requires all entities processing personal data to implement appropriate security measures. Failure to comply may result in administrative fines and legal sanctions."
Text 2: Excerpt from a Regulatory Compliance Notice

"Pursuant to Regulation No. 2024/15, financial institutions must submit quarterly reports detailing risk management procedures. Non-compliance shall result in penalties issued by the supervisory authority."

using at least three legal terms from the lesson.
